snippet.title: A Game About Digging A Hole Together - Official Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay from A Game About Digging A Hole Together in this trailer for the upcoming minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. A Game About Digging A Hole Together will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Cloud, and Game Pass on December 4, 2026. It will also be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
